note: vespera-bridge: multipart uploads through the servlet proxy now reach Rust byte-for-byte. The multipartResolver bean is wrapped in VesperaProxyMultipartResolver so DispatcherServlet no longer parses (drains) proxied multipart requests and Spring's multipart size limits no longer apply to them; Spring controllers keep normal multipart handling (opt out: vespera.bridge.multipart-passthrough=false). A multipart body consumed before the proxy is answered 500 with a clear message instead of being forwarded empty.
